customer.business: TextilWorld (online fabric by the meter, Poland)
customer.target: People in Poland who sew and buy fabric online by the meter: hobby sewers, small clothing-brand owners, fashion students and event decorators
customer.where: Poland, buying online (Shopify store or Allegro)

segments.name: Small clothing-brand owner or home seamstress selling online

behaviours.name: Allegro price-comparer
behaviours.how: Searches Allegro first, sorts by price including delivery, buys from whoever is cheapest with Smart delivery.

behaviours.name: Touch-first buyer
behaviours.how: Prefers a local fabric shop where she can feel the drape; buys online only when the shop doesn't have it.

behaviours.name: Colour perfectionist
behaviours.how: Has been burned by colours that looked different on screen; orders samples or asks for photos in daylight first.

behaviours.name: Collection bulk buyer
behaviours.how: Buys 10 to 30 metres at once for a small production run and watches the price per metre closely.

behaviours.name: Deadline buyer
behaviours.how: Needs the fabric for a specific event or order date; delivery speed and stock certainty matter more than price.

behaviours.name: Instagram/TikTok browser
behaviours.how: Discovers fabrics from sewing creators and buys on impulse when something looks beautiful.

behaviours.name: Loyal to one online shop
behaviours.how: Already has a favourite online fabric shop that knows her and rarely switches.

objections: Delivery will cost almost as much as the fabric
The colour on screen never matches the real thing
It's probably cheaper on Allegro from someone else
I can't feel the quality or the weight before buying
What if it's out of stock or stuck on pre-order when I need it?
I don't know this shop, are they reliable?
I need it by a specific date
habits: you sew most evenings after work
you follow several sewing creators on Instagram
you buy most things online through Allegro with Smart delivery
you pick up parcels from an InPost locker near your home
you have a sewing project due for a friend's wedding next month
you sell what you make on Etsy and Vinted

pitch:
TextilWorld (textilworld.pl): fabric sold by the metre, shipped from a warehouse near Warsaw.
Cut to order from 0.5 m, 150 cm wide: viscose, velvet/velour, chiffon, crepe, jersey knit, cotton, satin, muslin and more.
Example prices: plain black viscose 14.90 PLN/m, navy jersey knit 12.50 PLN/m, Cuba velour 24.90 PLN/m.
Delivery by InPost locker, DPD, DHL or ORLEN Paczka. Also sold on Allegro, Etsy and Amazon.de.
(For the four price questions, answer for 1 metre of the plain black viscose.)
